description: Unit tests for skia_utils_mac, testing conversion between SkBitmap and NSImage/NSBitmapImageRep on macOS, including color accuracy and image size.

classes.name: SkiaUtilsMacTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing Skia to macOS image conversions.

methods.name: CreateSkBitmap

methods.name: CreateNSImage

methods.name: TestImageRep
methods.description: Verifies that the NSBitmapImageRep has the expected color at a sample pixel.

methods.description: Tests conversion of SkBitmap to NSImage and NSBitmapImageRep, verifying size and color.
